title: WU JEN FIFTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 24 fifth level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R674 OA wu jen fifth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round sixty-one (capture pp. 189-196): the wu jen fifth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN FIFTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 189-196 - the OA wu jen fifth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 189-196; compressed pp. 87-91); all 24 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the variances typographic or prose-only (the fire breath save printed 1/z for the half, the wall of stone range garbled X12, the servant horde count 2d6 + 1 in the print against 2d6 - 1 in the compressed - a prose divergence outside the grid). The level is alteration-heavy yet again: 10 of the 24 spells, evocation eight, conjuration two, and FOUR lone-school spells - animate dead the lone necromantic, aiming at the target the lone invocation, shadow door the lone illusion, dismissal the lone abjuration with its odd triple-line print Abjuration Reversible (Conjuration/Summoning) pinned primary 7; no divination or enchantment/charm spell this level. The component census: 20 VSM, and TWO somatic-only spells (aiming at the target, shadow door) - the first somatic-only spells of the wu jen levels; animal growth and telekinesis the verbal and somatic pair; no verbal-only or V,M spell this level. The casting times: nine five-segment (the most common cast), six one-round, three three-segment, conjure elemental and major creation one-turn, animate dead the five-ROUND cast pinned 50 segments (the longest of the level), servant horde the lone single segment, shadow door two, sword of deception four. Three negation saves, cone of cold and fire breath the two half saves, no special save this level. Four spells read Reversible (animal growth, dismissal, water to poison, wood rot). The sixth column cross-checks the R669 element grid: the 13 tagged cells - the richest element column yet - matching the landed dieWJT66L5Element pins exactly, with water to poison carrying the Nature/Water dual code 9. The stat grid pins as a table: 24 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and element markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag WJL5Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
